rules.sourceText: For graph work, semantic entities/identities, typed assertions, evidence basis and unknowns precede projection. A projection cannot authorize new meaning or coverage. The bounded packet names the user's learning task, negative example, control/command scopes, state owners/lifetimes, allowlist and protected exceptions before derived edits. Tests derive from that contract; do not encode an unadopted composition such as two floating bars merely not overlapping. Separate engineering/source/visible-task/comprehension/device evidence. Repeated same-kind perceptual or ownership failure stops local patches and returns to the responsible contract; it does not authorize broad CSS/model/backend changes. Blocked review is incomplete. Reconcile conflicting owning norms before projection implementation, then obtain the required fresh whole-product docs reassessment.

rules.rule: Make committed regressions reachable through declared normal test entrypoint; reconcile new top-level suites with package inventory.

rules.sourceText: Every committed regression test must be reachable through the repository's declared normal test entrypoint. When adding a top-level `tests/*.test.ts` suite, reconcile that inventory with `package.json`'s explicit test command before accepting the change. Keep each suite under its intended runtime: the fixed four-file Bun source-core target remains separate from the explicit Node suite list. An ad hoc focused pass does not establish that the normal entrypoint executes the regression. Run the declared entrypoint and confirm the new cases appear in its actual output; preserve failures and execution limits. This is a maintenance obligation, not a new discovery framework or permission to change dependency/lock/runtime policy.

rules.sourceText: Each slice page is the Git-tracked execution handoff packet. Keep it at `docs/plans/<round>/slices/<slice>/plan.md`; if separate handoff or review files become useful, keep them in that same slice directory (for example handoffs/implementation.md and reviews/<candidate>.md) and link them from the plan. Round-wide review records stay under the owning round’s reviews/ directory. The maintained product docs outside plans are the durable specification; a packet coordinates work against them and does not replace them. Keep implementation and independent-review sections in that page, linking shared architecture, protocols and its parent round rather than copying them. Track packet revisions with Git; the dispatch identifies the exact committed plan revision, assigned role and permitted work. Refresh the packet when decisions, dependencies or candidate evidence change. A template or unresolved field is not a ready assignment.

rules.sourceText: Reconcile findings and observed acceptance into the slice. Before acceptance, promote all relevant learning and design into durable product docs outside plans, including user stories, observable acceptance, architecture, public interfaces, low-level semantics, rationale, failure/recovery and verified limits. Check that a fresh agent can derive the accepted delivered behavior and tests without the old plan, chat or application; explicitly record specification gaps rather than claiming an unperformed rebuild. Link the maintained source updates and supporting evidence from the slice. Then update every directly dependent slice plan with actual delivered interfaces, source identity, verified evidence, limitations, changed assumptions, reusable test assets and unresolved gates. Record the destination and effect of that contribution in the completed slice. The successor owner reconciles it before implementation and revises its own handoffs. Propagate material round/roadmap changes, without treating predecessor success as successor acceptance.

evidence.E-UNKNOWN: No complete current execution/history conformance audit; source presence is not evidence. UNKNOWN does not mean FAIL.
evidence.E-PROP: Owning document explicitly leaves this default/profile/threshold/session proposed until selected.
evidence.E-LOCAL: This audit read exact62afc041 Git objects from isolated integrate-pr25-reading-journey worktree; no app/network/runtime mutation or test execution.
evidence.E-CONFIG: package.json:17–20 declares current pure/E2E/owning strict commands; mockups/pr-file-tree/tsconfig.json:1 is strict. Configuration only, not a new run.
evidence.E-SOURCE: Independent fixed7681e278 source receipt in request-unit-test-inventory-review-2026-10-27.md; git diff7681e278..62afc041 for src/mockups/scripts/package/lock/compiler is empty. Bounded source findings remain bounded, not current runtime evidence.
evidence.E-ACTUAL: Recorded7681e278 actual desktop390 report/receipt in semantic-graph-recovery.md v15: no fake Before/member arrows and sampled preserved gestures. Source-informed actual review, not fresh unfamiliar comprehension, physical-device or this auditor execution.
evidence.E-HISTORY: projection-gap-audit-2026-10-27.md:19–31,44–72: missing logical-identity contract, one-record→one-card projection, count/retention tests and reviewers missed intended learning outcome. Historical failure retained, later correction separate.
evidence.E-READABILITY: At fixed62afc041, mockups/pr-file-tree/minimal-main.tsx:42–53 and graph-geometry.ts contain dense semicolon/one-line implementation. These are app implementation, not immutable reviewed-source fixtures.
evidence.E-REPAIRED: Fixed62afc041 protected-invariants.md:9–11,19,40 and semantic-graph.md historical qualifiers repair old c86/7ce current status, neutral-all colors, distinct ports/final-segment text and illustrative/test-unprepared ambiguity.
evidence.E-OPEN: Product index and current slice receipts keep full learningjourney/fresh unfamiliar comprehension/whole-product rebuild readiness/native dual-host/physical-device gates open. This source-informed audit cannot fill them.
evidence.E-FEED: review-experience.md:195,197 and documentation.md:62 record forward/back reality/gap/slice/Change provenance and forbid declaring gap resolved merely because targeted; no planning UI/schema authorized.

productNormativeCandidates.text: A successful test-request command means a job exists. Job launch, execution and terminal outcome require separate evidence. Cancellation records intent; cancelled requires confirmed termination. Missing launch or exit evidence remains unknown. External launches and wakeups use stable invocationId distinct from commandId, with host deduplication/query/reconciliation. Outbox replay does not guarantee exactly-once external effects. Unknown launch outcomes cannot be blindly retried; reuse of commandId with changed payload is rejected.

productNormativeCandidates.text: Follow the [progressive roadmap](../plans/roadmap.md), with testable vertical slices inside each round. Use established CLI session delivery and the [scoped integration checks](../plans/480p/probes/00-host-contract.md); App notifies the agent through CLI and the agent reads/replies through MCP. A generic host-feasibility experiment is not a prerequisite to product code. productNormativeCandidates.text: Write detection must follow lexical binding identity for ordinary assignments, updates, destructuring and iteration assignment targets. In a destructuring shorthand, the compiler's property symbol and written value binding are distinct; using only the property symbol can falsely confirm a later call to a reassigned function. Inspect the written value binding, and do not mark unrelated right-hand/default-value expressions as binding writes. This rule follows the immutability policy rather than assuming a const keyword proves no observed write. Named function-expression recursion may resolve to its owning supported const implementation; passing that expression as a callback still does not establish an invocation.

New disclosure or anchor-confirmation controls need accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus. In narrow layouts a long story title may wrap, while the adjacent Flow/Diff labels remain on one line and retain their controls. Keep independent UI critique separate from tests and screenshot geometry. A successful correction requires a fresh graph/story-first account frozen before source/key, source comparison, an explicit cognitive-burden verdict and the meaningful question/reply/return journey; a shorter screenshot or passing DOM assertion alone does not establish understanding.

productNormativeCandidates.text: `questionEvidenceProjection` reports ready, blocked or unavailable. Ready requires an authenticated active unsent draft, exact snapshot-source reference, matching retained source hash and valid snapshot LF anchor. The proposed anchor snapshot must equal both the active/displayed story snapshot ID and the loaded snapshot object ID. Historical evidence from snapshot S while T is active is unavailable, even if its path and body hash match. Adoption never navigates across snapshots or leaves a private draft anchored to another snapshot; the unavailable reason points to explicit snapshot navigation instead. Pending or submitted drafts are blocked. Non-source and semantic-only references are unavailable for this bounded port; no UTF-16-to-LF conversion or fabricated snapshot mapping is added. The read model carries the exact evidence, active draft, proposed anchor, mismatch indication and whether nonempty text needs confirmation. React displays the proposal and collects confirmation; it does not decide eligibility. The explicit `adoptEvidence` application operation rechecks the current proposal against the supplied one, including text, parent, draft identity, source reference and anchor. A changed proposal is superseded and must be inspected/confirmed again. Pending state is checked before adoption. Confirmed adoption preserves draft text/parent/identity and original return frame, replaces only the active draft anchor, removes the old comparison key and pauses. It creates no command or receipt and does not change persisted private-session formats. No ordinary navigation path gains this exception to the nonempty-draft source guard.

productNormativeCandidates.section: Retained evidence facade and atomic owner
productNormativeCandidates.text: The public `store.storyEvidence(token, query)` accepts review/snapshot IDs, optional paired analysis/corpus IDs and up to256 unique strict references. It authenticates and authorizes using the existing owner's credential/attachment checks, reads immutable snapshot and admitted analysis through public read/source ports, then returns a normalized `StoryEvidence` account of valid references plus invalid references/reasons, selected analysis marker, `basisUnavailable`, and `facts` (exact static reference with retained semantic anchors and separately normalized `snapshotAnchors` for focus validation). It never accepts caller-supplied facts, a path to read, an unadmitted preparation result or new source bytes. The story store receives this owner-created resolver as a private port; callers cannot supply an evidence bundle to command publication. Indexed maps cover source/file/fact membership; semantic source text is fetched once per unique identity. Public `validateSemanticAnchor(source, anchor)` accepts retained source content/hash/snapshot/side/path and an anchor, returns boolean only, and rejects identity/hash/empty/out-of-range or mismatched line coordinates. The shared pure semantic coordinate validator preserves CRLF, U2028/U2029 and UTF-16 offset semantics and is reused by graph clarifications. For every cited static fact, the owner resolves its semantic anchors against the exact retained corpus source, validates parser coordinates, and retains those anchors unchanged. When that same snapshot/side/path/hash and identical text also exists in the snapshot source manifest, the owner separately computes its LF-based start/end line span from the semantic UTF-16 offsets (end exclusive). These normalized snapshot-source reference values appear in `facts.snapshotAnchors`; absent snapshot text yields no snapshot mapping, never a guessed anchor. LF indexes use only U+000A; parser U+2028/U+2029/CR-only boundaries do not create snapshot LF lines, and CRLF/astral offsets are preserved. Domain static-claim/focus matching compares semantic references only with the semantic anchors and snapshot references only with these owner-normalized snapshot anchors, never directly with parser line numbers. A same-body/hash match is required before normalization. Context capture resolution stays with the story owner and exact context selection. Public `store.analysis.marker(token, {reviewId, snapshotId})` returns only reviewId/snapshotId/currentSnapshotId/analysisGeneration/graphRevision/selectedAnalysisId after existing credential, review and retained-snapshot authorization. It never loads corpus/inventory/analysis/preparation bodies. Story evidence uses this marker for current-selection labels even when unrelated retained analysis bodies are missing. Authored-basis resolution uses a separate strict public `store.analysis.evidence(token, {reviewId, snapshotId, analysisId})` read (`analysisEvidenceQuerySchema`, AnalysisEvidenceQuery/AnalysisEvidence). After the same credential/review/snapshot authorization, it requires an admitted job for that exact analysis ID and returns only reviewId/snapshotId/analysisId, that job’s retained corpus account and analysis result, and clarifications belonging to that analysis. It scans retained job records to locate the exact admitted job. It does not load unrelated semantic/preparation bodies, the current preparation projection, a newer corpus or unrelated inventory. Missing authored records remain analysis_record_unavailable. The general AnalysisView/query projection keeps its existing current-preparation semantics; it is not the story-evidence dependency. Historical publication/readback therefore remains available when only a newer corpus is missing, while absence of the story’s own corpus remains explicit broken evidence. Exact authored-basis reads classify only known retained-data failures (`analysis_record_unavailable` or `source_unavailable`) as basisUnavailable; invalid identity checks yield story_reference_invalid. Referenced bodies remain immutable in story readback with explicit brokenEvidence/basisUnavailable. The retained-analysis record owner classifies malformed stored JSON as analysis_record_unavailable at its parse boundary; unrelated SQL or programming failures are not reclassified. Authentication/stale-attachment and unexpected storage/programming errors propagate, never become an invented empty fact set.

productNormativeCandidates.section: B1 review correction: evidence, byte transport and disposable ownership
productNormativeCandidates.text: A result records bounded pre/post verification observations: completion time, source/closure comparison disposition and measured/expected inventory digests with changed-entry count, runtime/config comparison included in the composite inputs disposition, overlay inventory digest and count/bytes, and absence/error reasons when a stage was not reached or could not complete. Complete owned overlay inventories and at most 128 changed source paths (with total count and truncation flag) are retained in source evidence. Before test execution all owned `home`, `tmp`, `config`, `empty`, and `cache` directories must be empty. After quiescence, `home`, `tmp`, `config`, and `empty` must still be empty; the only expected cache files are `cache/bun/@t@/<16 lowercase hex>.pile`, beneath only `bun` and `bun/@t@` directories. This is the observed Bun 1.4.2 cache shape (86 files / 11,680,213 bytes in the retained exact `098867e` engineering run), not proof of origin from a filename. The overlay account allows at most 512 files, 32 directories, 16 MiB per file, 32 MiB total, depth 4, and 5 seconds per inventory, all within the attempt verification deadline. Links, special files, extra directories, unexpected files, source mutations or incomplete accounting prevent pass. This trusted-local-target policy is not an OS sandbox or arbitrary-code safety guarantee.

productNormativeCandidates.section: B1 review correction: evidence, byte transport and disposable ownership
productNormativeCandidates.text: Result admission atomically records a pending disposable-root cleanup record, bound to that invocation's sole registered UUID root and observed canonical parent/root filesystem identity; absence is explicit. Cleanup is permitted only for an admitted completed invocation with confirmed quiescence and current owner epoch. The exact private disposable root is removed after admission; artifact/result storage remains. Public job cleanup state is `pending`, `complete`, or `error`, with attempts and a bounded reason. An absent cleanup value means no admitted cleanup ownership record (including legacy records), not successful deletion. If root creation was attempted but its identity could not be captured, completion stays unknown rather than inventing deletion authority. A failed attempt retains its private locator and persists a retry time; automatic retries use a capped 60-second delay and at most eight records per owner tick. Startup resumes only admitted cleanup records, never preparation or tests. Each attempt rechecks the owner, terminal identity, registered root and absence of owned groups before filesystem work; changed root identity, links, unknown/legacy ambiguous invocation, or owner loss grant no deletion. Absent already-deleted roots complete idempotently. Deletion scans at most 50,000 entries to depth 132 within 10 seconds, rejects links/special files and checks the current owner before each deletion. Existing terminal records without this private ownership metadata are historical, not permission to infer and delete a root. Cleanup changes job revision but never rewrites the admitted canonical result or receipt. Disposable disk remains explicitly pending until deletion; a retryable cleanup does not occupy the process slot, and further test claims pause while admitted cleanup is outstanding to avoid unbounded retained working trees. No public force-clear or cleanup path input exists.

Backward reading: Change (code + docs) → addressed slice (targeted gap or chosen partial scope) → original observed gap → expected reality → previous observed reality. A partial gap is optional scoped work within the original evidenced gap, not an invented problem or mandatory new ontology level. Record actual links and distinguish recorded author intent from a later inferred reconstruction; do not invent missing provenance or runtime claims from the diff.
